amendment: Exploratory follow-up to the en-de CometKiwi-23-XL refusal collapse: 6 GRPO runs at 1000 steps (3 seeds x {unguarded, off-target-language guard}). All other settings are those of results/grpo_ende_protocol.json. Not a test of the frozen audit rule; runs are reported separately and never enter the rule scorecard.

guard.definition: reward - 1.0 if off_target(output, 'German') (src/hack_guards.py): GlotLID top-1 label != deu_Latn, outputs with >= 4 whitespace words only. Same -1.0 penalty form as the existing replication guard. Existing copy/truncation/repetition flags are NOT applied.
guard.design_data_disclosure: Min-word threshold and model chosen 2026-11-09 after inspecting step-0 en-de/en-es eval outputs and the seed-0/1 step-500 refusals: flags 367/367 and 352/353 refusals; flags 10/400 en-de and 9/422 en-es step-0 outputs, of which 7 and 6 are already flagged untranslated.
guard.name: langid

indicators: refusal_count (regex in src/analyze_grpo_rule_tests.py), off_target_rate (definition above), plus the frozen untranslated/truncation/repetition rates.
outcome_access: Written after all 12 en-de 500-step outcomes were seen; no 1000-step or guarded en-de run existed.

predictions.H1_horizon: Unguarded: final (step-1000) eval refusal count >= 200/400 in at least 2 of 3 seeds. If seed-2-style runs stay clean at 1000 steps, collapse is seed-dependent rather than a matter of time.
predictions.H2_guard: Guarded: final off-target rate <= initial + 0.02 in all 3 seeds, and final mean CometKiwi-23-XL >= initial (0.444).
predictions.H3_quality_crosscheck: Guarded final mean XCOMET-XL-QE, CometKiwi-22 and MetricX-24-QE each >= their step-0 values in all 3 seeds.

steps_note: max_steps=1000 also stretches TRL's linear LR decay over 1000 steps, so steps 0-500 are not identical to the 500-step runs. Checkpoints every 100 steps; eval at 0,100,...,1000.
